item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.41)] Switch to Verizon and get the new iPhone 18 Pro now. No trade-in needed. And get the latest iPhone every year.
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.41)
Verizon is offering the new iPhone 18 Pro with no trade-in required and the option to upgrade to the latest iPhone every year through its Simplicity plan. Customers can also get additional Apple products like the Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, AirPods 5, and the new foldable iPhone Duo. The announcement highlights Verizon's loyalty program, which includes no activation or upgrade fees and Verizon Dollars cash back.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Neutral (-0.13)] eBay CEO Jamie Iannone sells $2.29 million in company stock
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Neutral (-0.13)
eBay CEO Jamie Iannone sold 22,220 shares of company stock in early September 2026, totaling approximately $2.29 million, executed under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Despite the sales, Iannone still holds a significant number of direct and indirect shares. The company recently reported strong Q2 results, exceeding analyst expectations and leading to raised full-year guidance and positive analyst ratings.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.15)] Apple SVP Jennifer Newstead sells $456,176 of company stock
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.15)
Jennifer Newstead, Apple's SVP, General Counsel, and Government Affairs, sold 1,438 shares of AAPL stock for $456,176 on September 8, 2026, as part of a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Following the sale, she directly owns 34,352 shares. Apple shares are trading near their 52-week high and are considered overvalued by InvestingPro, despite the recent introduction of a new foldable iPhone model, the Duo.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.14), MSFT Bullish (+0.44), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)] Microsoft plans 38 gigawatts of data center capacity by 2032, Bloomberg News reports
item.category: AAPL Neutral (-0.14), MSFT Bullish (+0.44), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.14), MSFT Bullish (+0.44), NVDA Bullish (+0.35)
Microsoft intends to significantly expand its data center capacity to 38 gigawatts by 2032, more than tripling its current footprint of 12 gigawatts, according to a Bloomberg News report. A growing portion of this expansion, about one-third, will be dedicated to AI-specific chips, reflecting the massive computing power required for generative AI services. The company expects substantial capital expenditures, with plans to spread long-term data center leases over 25 years to lower annual reported costs.

item.title: [NVDA Bearish (-0.34)] Chinese Nvidia rival Enflame soars 206% on stock market debut as AI demand stays hot
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bearish (-0.34)
Chinese chipmaker Enflame, a domestic rival to Nvidia, saw its stock surge 206% on its Shanghai market debut, drawing significant investor interest. The company is the last of China's "four little dragons" of AI chipmaking to go public, aiming to use IPO proceeds to develop next-generation AI chips and contribute to China's tech self-sufficiency amidst U.S. export controls. Enflame reported increased revenue in 2025, reflecting the growing demand for AI chip development in China.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.40), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Container Management
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.40), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Container Management, positioned furthest to the right on Completeness of Vision. This acknowledgment highlights Microsoft's ability to help customers modernize applications and integrate AI workloads without increasing operational complexity, particularly as container platforms adapt to a broader range of workloads and deployment environments. The company's container portfolio, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, Azure Arc, and Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager, provides a consistent operating model across cloud, edge, and hybrid deployments, supporting both persistent AI serving layers and on-demand inference.

item.title: [AMZN Bearish (-0.63)] NTSB Says Amazon Boeing Pilots Appeared to Consider Aborting Landing Before Deadly Miami Crash
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bearish (-0.63)
The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) suggests that pilots of the Amazon "Prime Air" Boeing cargo plane might have considered aborting their landing before a fatal crash in Miami. NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy revealed that flight data showed increased throttle consistent with a "go-around" thrust shortly before the crash, which resulted in five fatalities. The agency will interview the pilots and release cockpit voice recorder readouts as part of its investigation into the incident.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.40)] Super Micro Computer Sees $60B AI Order Book Powering Fiscal 2027 Outlook
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.40)
Super Micro Computer announced a $60 billion AI order book, supporting its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook of $65 billion to $72 billion. The company is focusing on integrated "AI factory" systems to meet strong demand and expects to maintain double-digit gross margins. Supermicro is also expanding its customer base beyond neocloud to include enterprise and sovereign AI markets, alongside growing its manufacturing capabilities.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.21)] Apple is walking a ‘tightrope’ when it comes to the prices of its new iPhones
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.21)
Apple is facing a pricing dilemma for its new iPhones, including the iPhone 18 Pro line and its first foldable phone, the Duo. Analysts suggest the company may need to absorb some costs to maintain sales amidst rising inflation and constrained consumer spending. The challenge lies in balancing increased production costs with consumers' limited ability to pay higher prices for new devices.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.32), NVDA Bullish (+0.45), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Jim Cramer Says He’s ‘Not Going to Give Up on Nvidia’ Stock: Here’s His Suggestion for CEO Jensen Huang
item.category: MSFT Bullish (+0.32), NVDA Bullish (+0.45), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.32), NVDA Bullish (+0.45), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
Jim Cramer remains bullish on Nvidia (NVDA) despite its recent financial results not pushing the stock to all-time highs. He suggests Nvidia conduct a $500 billion share buyback, arguing it would demonstrate strong conviction and be the best investment CEO Jensen Huang could make at 14x earnings. Cramer also expressed confidence in hyperscaler stocks like Amazon, Microsoft, and Alphabet, anticipating spectacular data center numbers from them next year.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.33)] Hyperscalers Bet on AI & Quantum: Watch GOOGL, AMZN, IBM in September
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.33)
Hyperscalers like Alphabet, Amazon, and IBM are investing heavily in AI infrastructure, with Alphabet planning $195-$205 billion in 2026 capital spending. While AI buildout is a major focus, quantum computing, though garnering increased government funding, remains a longer-term investment with smaller commercial revenues. Investors are advised to consider established tech companies for quantum exposure, as they offer the advantage of current commercial demand from their AI and cloud businesses to support these long-term ventures.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.43), NVDA Bullish (+0.25)] Microsoft 2.5: EVP Pavan Davuluri wants to remake Windows for both human and agent users
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.43), NVDA Bullish (+0.25)
Pavan Davuluri, EVP of Windows + Devices at Microsoft, is leading an initiative to evolve Windows to support both human users and "agentic workloads" in the "Microsoft 2.5" era. Despite earlier backlash for labeling Windows an "agentic OS," Davuluri maintains the platform will integrate AI agents by focusing on low-level capabilities like security and identity, rather than immediate UI changes. He emphasizes a "full-stack" approach, customer obsession, and improved quality, with hardware like Surface playing a key role in developing and optimizing underlying technologies for this future.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.09)] BofA Tweaks Apple Stock Price Target After Ternus Debut
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.09)
Bank of America maintained its Buy rating on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) but lowered its price target from $380 to $370 after CEO John Ternus's first product event. The adjustment reflects softer-than-expected new iPhone pricing, which could boost sales volume but pressure gross margins due to rising component costs. Despite increased iPhone unit estimates for 2026 and 2027, the reduced average selling prices led to lower profit expectations, although confidence in Apple's long-term strategy remains strong, particularly with the introduction of the foldable iPhone Duo and advancements in AI and privacy.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.00)] The Apple Watch Got a Massive AI Upgrade—and the Controversy Could Get It Banned at the Office
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.00)
The new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 feature advanced AI capabilities like Live Rewind and Siri Recap, which record and summarize conversations. While Sound Recognition offers useful accessibility features, the Live Rewind and Siri Recap functionalities raise significant privacy concerns for corporate environments. Companies may consider banning these devices in meetings due to the risk of business secrets leaking.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14), MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)] QYLD ETF Explained: How an $8.3 Billion Covered Call Strategy Delivers 12% Monthly Income
item.category: AAPL Neutral (+0.14), MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14), MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)
The QYLD ETF utilizes a covered call strategy on the Nasdaq 100 Index to generate monthly income, boasting an $8.3 billion AUM and a 12.21% trailing twelve-month distribution yield. While it aims for current income, investors should note that this strategy caps upside potential in exchange for regular distributions from option premiums. The fund's holdings mirror the Nasdaq 100, and its performance is tied to the index's direction and volatility.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.46)] Apple catches up in foldables. Wall Street likes it
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.46)
Apple has unveiled its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, priced from $1,999, entering a market previously dominated by Samsung, Google, and Huawei. Analysts are largely positive, with Bank of America seeing a larger market opportunity and UBS expecting Apple to sell over 5 million foldable units in fiscal 2026. This launch also marks new CEO John Ternus's first major product introduction, emphasizing Apple's focus on integrated hardware, software, and services.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.21)] Surge in Data Center Power Demand Forecasted
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.21)
Goldman Sachs projects a significant surge in U.S. data center power demand to nearly 108 gigawatts by 2030, creating substantial opportunities for utilities like American Electric Power (AEP) and infrastructure providers such as Vertiv. AEP plans to invest $78 billion to meet this demand, while Vertiv anticipates over 20% year-over-year revenue growth due to evolving data center designs. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for AEP, with some recent price target adjustments.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.24), NVDA Bullish (+0.24)] Lam Research CEO Timothy Archer sells $9.58 million in company stock
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.24), NVDA Bullish (+0.24)
Lam Research CEO Timothy Archer sold 30,000 shares of company stock for $9.58 million, following a 196% surge in the stock over the past year. Concurrently, he acquired 30,000 shares through employee stock options, valued at $900,990. The sale was executed under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, and Archer's direct holdings now stand at 1,075,966 shares.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Nvidia, Palantir and Rackspace Just Built an AI Trifecta — Here's the Trade
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Rackspace Technology, in collaboration with Nvidia and Palantir, has launched an "AI Trifecta" product designed for enterprises and governments needing sovereign AI. This initiative combines Nvidia's Blackwell chip platform, Palantir's Foundry and AIP software, and Rackspace's private cloud environment, focusing on accountability and managed operations for regulated industries. Investors can consider Rackspace for high-beta exposure, or Nvidia and Palantir for more stable investments in the sovereign AI theme.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.13)] Analog Devices Wants Robots to Think Without Nvidia | Is ADI the Next Big AI Stock?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.13)
Analog Devices (ADI) is investing up to $200 million to acquire Alif Semiconductor, aiming to embed AI decision-making directly into devices like robots and pacemakers, bypassing cloud processing. This strategy targets the edge inference market, distinct from Nvidia's data center GPU training, focusing on low-power embedded devices. While analysts are bullish on ADI, the Alif deal's impact on revenue is expected to take several years to materialize, positioning ADI as a player in localized AI.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.10)] RB Global Inc stock hits 52-week low at 80.62 USD
item.description:

RB Global Inc (RBA) stock has fallen to a 52-week low of $80.62, representing a 31.94% decrease over the past year. Despite the downturn, InvestingPro data suggests the stock is undervalued and oversold, potentially indicating a buying opportunity. The company recently reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.32 billion, exceeding forecasts, although adjusted EPS missed expectations.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.34)] SolarEdge Advances Full DC Powertrain for AI Data Centers, Publishes 800 VDC Protection Framework With NVIDIA
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.34)
SolarEdge Technologies (NASDAQ: SEDG) announced that its DC powertrain for AI data centers now has its medium-voltage to 800 VDC conversion stage operating under load. Concurrently, SolarEdge, in collaboration with NVIDIA, released a white paper titled "800 VDC Protection and Grounding for AI Data Centers," providing a technology-neutral framework for safe and reliable 800 VDC system deployment. This joint effort aims to establish common protection and grounding practices as the industry shifts towards 800 VDC distribution in data centers.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.24)] Lam Research director Bethany Mayer sells $3m in shares

This transaction occurred after a 196% surge in the company's stock over the past year, with the stock trading at $300.76 at the time of the article.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.47)] Nvidia’s Huang says cybersecurity will be next major AI use case
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.30), NVDA Bullish (+0.47)
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that cybersecurity will be the next significant application for artificial intelligence, highlighting AI's disruptive potential in defending computer systems. He emphasized that AI automation in programming is changing the cybersecurity landscape due to the rapid exploitation of code. Huang also addressed investor concerns regarding Nvidia's acquisition strategy, noting that the company invests in "sure things" with established customer demand.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14)] Skyworks Solutions Surges 10%, Qorvo Climbs 6% While Chip Stocks Fall: Is the Merger Finally Clearing?
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.14)
Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) and Qorvo (QRVO) saw significant stock surges of 10% and 6% respectively, while the broader semiconductor market experienced a decline. This divergence suggests that the market is pricing in increased optimism for their proposed merger, as Skyworks' CEO Phil Brace previously indicated the China review had entered its final phase with a target close by year-end. Investors are closely watching for formal regulatory decisions or merger-completion disclosures as the transaction appears to be nearing its conclusion.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.70)] Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang isn't mincing words about the company's trajectory. With continuous momentum in AI infrastructure, Huang expressed strong confidence in maintaining rapid expansion.
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.70)
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed strong confidence in the company's continued rapid expansion, citing ongoing momentum in AI infrastructure. The article highlights Huang's unwavering conviction in Nvidia's future trajectory.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11)] Salesforce Might Pay $2 Billion for This AI Company. Is the ‘SaaSpocalypse’ Finally Over?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11)
Salesforce is reportedly considering acquiring AI-driven customer insights firm Listen Labs for $2 billion, a move that could significantly enhance its AI platform, Agentforce. Listen Labs specializes in AI-powered customer research, serving major clients like Google and Microsoft, and has seen rapid revenue growth. This potential acquisition signals Salesforce's strategy to deepen its AI capabilities beyond automation and could be a positive indicator for the broader AI economy.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11)] Adobe set for inline Q3 results as new CEO era begins amid AI valuation reset
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11)
Adobe Inc. is expected to report Q3 results that align with guidance, as the company faces a leadership change with the appointment of Anil Chakravarthy as CEO and ongoing concerns about AI disruption. Jefferies projects $6.7 billion in revenue and a 44% operating margin, while noting that Adobe's stock remains undervalued despite a recent rally, trading at roughly 10 times calendar 2027 enterprise value to free cash flow. The firm seeks more convincing evidence of organic revenue growth acceleration to become more constructive on the stock.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.42)] Detect and disrupt AI-themed attacks with Microsoft Defender
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.42)
Cyberattackers are exploiting the popularity and trust associated with AI platforms like ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, DeepSeek, and Claude to conduct sophisticated phishing, malware, and malvertising campaigns. Microsoft Defender offers comprehensive protection against these AI-themed lures, leveraging anti-phishing policies, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, and attack disruption capabilities to prevent and neutralize multi-stage attacks across email, identity, and endpoints. The article emphasizes that while the lures are new, the underlying attack tactics remain the same, requiring a holistic security approach rather than isolated incident assessment.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.31), NVDA Bullish (+0.41)] Insider Mark Stevens Just Sold Nearly 2 Million Shares of Nvidia Stock
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.31), NVDA Bullish (+0.41)
Nvidia director Mark A. Stevens recently sold 1.85 million shares of NVDA stock worth $410.84 million, an event that typically signals bearish sentiment but is not the case here. Stevens still holds a significant stake, and the sale occurred after Nvidia reported strong Q2 results and announced its intent to acquire Hugging Face. Analysts maintain a "Strong Buy" rating on NVDA, seeing the acquisition as a strategic move to strengthen Nvidia's AI ecosystem.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.49)] Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang isn't mincing words about the company's trajectory. With continuous momentum in AI infrastructure, Huang expressed strong confidence in maintaining rapid expansion.
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.49)
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is highly confident about the company's future growth, driven by continuous momentum in AI infrastructure. He expressed strong belief in maintaining rapid expansion for Nvidia.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.00)] SolarEdge Falls 4% on Analyst Day Despite Joint NVIDIA 800 VDC Paper; Enphase Energy and First Solar Edge Higher
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.00)
SolarEdge Technologies saw its stock fall 4% on its Analyst Day, even after announcing a joint white paper with NVIDIA on 800 VDC power architecture for AI data centers. This decline occurred while solar peers like Enphase Energy and First Solar saw gains, suggesting the market is looking for concrete revenue timing and customer details rather than just lab results. While SolarEdge's core business shows a turnaround with revenue growth and improved gross margin, its AI data center segment still needs commercial proof to justify its valuation.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (-0.07)] Apple's foldable iPhone is 'not new': AT&T CEO
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (-0.07)
AT&T CEO John Stankey commented on Apple's entry into the foldable phone market, stating that the concept is "not new" as Android devices have offered foldable options for years. He suggested that foldable phones serve a niche market and questioned whether Apple's version would significantly alter penetration dynamics, especially given the rising prices of iPhones which are causing consumers to hold onto devices longer. Stankey also discussed how AT&T plans to support new form factors and consumer purchasing behaviors.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.30)] 3 Reasons to Avoid PENG and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.30)
This article advises investors to avoid Penguin Solutions (PENG) despite its recent stock price surge. The author presents three main reasons for this caution: disappointing long-term revenue growth, low gross profit margins indicating weak structural profitability, and mediocre free cash flow margins limiting reinvestment potential. Instead, the article suggests investing in a top digital advertising platform riding the creator economy and highlights other strong momentum stocks identified by StockStory's AI platform.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.10), NVDA Bullish (+0.28)] Forget the Magnificent Seven Stocks, Gary Black Says This Tech Giant Is Cheaper
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.10), NVDA Bullish (+0.28)
Gary Black, Managing Partner at Future Fund, suggests that Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) is a cheaper investment compared to the Magnificent Seven stocks, based on its valuation metrics after a recent earnings dip. He highlights Broadcom's low price-to-earnings growth (PEG) ratio of 0.9x for 2026, making it the most affordable among what he terms the "Mag 8." Despite a post-earnings share drop, Black anticipates a recovery due to strong AI revenue growth, with third-quarter AI revenue up 221% year-over-year and promising guidance for fiscal 2026.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.48)] Build apps in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.48)
Microsoft is introducing natural language app building capabilities in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio, allowing users to create business applications using conversational prompts. These new features enable users to connect apps to enterprise data, ensure secure operations, and integrate them into existing business processes. The platform also provides IT administrators with centralized governance and control over these newly built applications.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.28)] Prediction: Broadcom Could Become One of the World’s Most Valuable Tech Companies
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.28)
Broadcom's AI semiconductor revenue saw a significant 221% year-over-year surge, driving speculation that the company could challenge NVIDIA's market cap dominance. Despite a recent stock pullback, analysts are optimistic about Broadcom's future, projecting substantial AI semiconductor revenue growth and a high confidence "BUY" rating. The company's strategy of securing custom chip contracts with major hyperscalers like Google and Meta is a key factor in its projected growth, positioning it strongly against competitors.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.22)] Ross Dress for Less coming to Somers Point
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.22)
Ross Dress for Less is set to open a new store in Somers Point's Ocean Heights Plaza on October 10, occupying the former Staples space. This 24,000-square-foot location will be the retailer's second in Atlantic County, enhancing the shopping center's appeal with its discounted name-brand apparel and home goods. The addition signifies continued commercial growth and confidence in Somers Point, joining other recent openings like Dave’s Hot Chicken and Jersey Mike’s Subs at the busy plaza.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.23)] Form 8K Ivanhoe Electric Inc For: 10 September By Investing.com
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.23)
This article announces the filing of a Form 8K by Ivanhoe Electric Inc. on September 10. The filing is provided by Investing.com, a financial markets platform.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.25)] UBS reiterates Gartner stock rating citing contract value trends
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.25)
UBS has reiterated a Neutral rating and $196.00 price target for Gartner (NYSE:IT) shares, following investor meetings where the company expressed optimism about contract value re-acceleration. Despite a 33% year-to-date decline in stock price, InvestingPro analysis suggests Gartner is undervalued. The company anticipates ex-Federal contract value growth to re-accelerate in the second half of the year, although buybacks are expected to be more moderate in Q3 due to recent stock appreciation.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.49)] RBC Capital reiterates Microsoft stock rating on Azure growth
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.49)
RBC Capital has reaffirmed its Outperform rating and $640.00 price target for Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) after updating its model to reflect Microsoft's new reporting structure, which now features Azure as a standalone segment. The firm highlighted Azure's continued momentum with 44-45% constant currency growth guidance and Microsoft's overall 18% revenue growth to $332 billion over the past year. InvestingPro data suggests Microsoft is undervalued, with numerous analysts revising earnings estimates upwards, reinforcing confidence in its growth trajectory.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14)] Salesforce unveils Trusted Enterprise AI Harness
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14)
Salesforce has previewed its new Trusted Enterprise AI Harness, a platform designed to govern multiple AI agent orchestration platforms that enterprises commonly use. The Harness bundles six capabilities—Trusted Context, Agency, Action, Governance, Security, and Models—alongside an AI Control Plane, aiming to provide a unified approach to managing AI agents and their interactions with proprietary business data and processes. While the full Harness will not be available until early 2027, Salesforce emphasizes that its modular architecture allows companies to integrate its components with existing systems, addressing the multi-platform reality of enterprise AI.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.09)] UBS reiterates Apple stock neutral rating on foldable iPhone launch
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.09)
UBS has reiterated a Neutral rating and a $296.00 price target for Apple Inc. following the company's product announcement, which included a new foldable iPhone called the Duo, starting at $1,999. The stock is currently trading above this target at $319.60, and InvestingPro analysis suggests it is overvalued with a P/E ratio of 36.25. Apple also raised prices for its Pro and Pro Max models by $100, a move UBS believes doesn't fully offset higher memory costs but avoids impacting demand too heavily.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.02)] Widow sues Amazon after Miami cargo jet crash killed 5 plane cleaners
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.02)
The widow of one of five aircraft cleaners killed in a Miami International Airport cargo jet crash is suing Amazon, the plane's operator, and others. The lawsuit alleges pilot errors, safety failures, and issues with the 32-year-old Boeing 767 contributed to the accident. The complaint claims the Amazon Air jet approached the runway significantly faster than normal and overran it, striking a van carrying cleaning crew members.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.34)] Attackers call employees’ personal phones to break into Microsoft 365 accounts
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.34)
Attackers are using social engineering tactics by calling or texting employees on personal phones, posing as IT staff, to gain unauthorized access to corporate Microsoft 365 accounts. Once inside, they exploit Microsoft Graph API to extract files and emails from various applications, maintaining persistence by registering their own MFA methods. This campaign, tracked since May 2026, focuses on stealthy data exfiltration below typical detection thresholds.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.24), AMZN Bullish (+0.24)] Microsoft Remains Down Over 12 Months: A Wall Street Bull Expects 75% Gains to Materialize Soon
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.24), AMZN Bullish (+0.24)
Despite Azure's milestones and 55 bullish analyst ratings, Microsoft's shares have stagnated over the past year, underperforming the broader market. One analyst, Arete Research, sees potential for a 77% upside, driven by Copilot's expansion, Azure's role in AI, and high switching costs. The market is currently discounting near-term free cash flow compression due to significant capital expenditures on AI infrastructure, but forward estimates and analyst revisions remain largely positive.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.24)] ATIF Holdings completes acquisition of GoldCoin Labs By Investing.com
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.24)
ATIF Holdings Limited (NASDAQ:ATIF) has completed its acquisition of GoldCoin Labs Limited, a British Virgin Islands company focused on developing gold-backed digital asset issuance infrastructure. The acquisition involved ATIF issuing 2,815,005 ordinary shares, valued at approximately $20 million, to GoldCoin's sole shareholder. GoldCoin is developing Metra Gold (GOLDM), a tokenized digital representation of physical gold, with each token intended to be backed 1:1 by one gram of fine gold.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.14)] Somnigroup International (NYSE:SGI) Raised to "Hold" at Zacks Research
item.description:

Zacks Research has upgraded Somnigroup International (NYSE:SGI) from "strong sell" to "hold," with the company still maintaining an overall "Moderate Buy" rating from analysts. The stock opened at $68.28, significantly below its 12-month high, despite meeting quarterly earnings expectations of $0.58 per share on $1.82 billion in revenue, which saw a 3% year-over-year decline. Insider activity shows CEO Scott Thompson purchased 30,000 shares for $1.89 million, while institutional investors hold a substantial 99.86% of the company's stock.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.46), MSFT Neutral (+0.14)] Prediction: Apple Stock Could Be Headed for a Big Move After Yesterday’s Event
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.46), MSFT Neutral (+0.14)
Following Apple's fall product event, options traders are anticipating a significant stock swing, roughly three times the typical post-event movement. 24/7 Wall St. maintains a "Buy" rating for Apple with a price target of $362.61, implying a 15.07% upside, primarily driven by a predicted Siri AI upgrade cycle. However, potential bear risks include memory inflation affecting gross margins and regulatory friction for Siri AI.

item.title: [TSM Bullish (+0.52)] ASML and TSMC Announce Initiative to Pioneer Industry Transition to Large-Format Photomasks for High NA EUV
item.description:

The initiative plans for a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031, with full lithography system readiness for advanced node production by 2033.

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.01)] Why Taiwan’s Silicon Shield Is Failing
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.01)
Taiwan's "silicon shield," stemming from its dominance in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, is facing challenges as China invests heavily in chip self-reliance, particularly in mature-node chips. While Taiwan still holds leverage in cutting-edge chips, China's increasing capacity in 28-nanometer chips threatens to make Taiwan's shield irrelevant for its own economy, potentially leading to a more fragile global trade environment with rising chip prices. This shift means that the geopolitical importance of Taiwan's chip production will no longer solely rely on the most advanced technologies, but also on the control of common chip manufacturing.

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.02)] Where Does AMD Make Its Processors?
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.02)
AMD processors are primarily manufactured in Taiwan by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), the world's largest semiconductor producer. While TSMC has facilities in Arizona for some AI chips, the final assembly and packaging of AMD CPUs occur in places like Penang, Malaysia, and China. This manufacturing strategy is similar to Nvidia's, with TSMC also producing chips for other major tech companies like Apple and Tesla.

item.title: [TSM Bullish (+0.48)] Marvell Technology and Taiwan Semiconductor are No-Brainer Picks: They Have What Wins in a Gold Rush
item.description:

Both companies reported impressive Q2 revenue growth (around 36%), with TSMC demonstrating broad market exposure through its foundry services and Marvell focusing on custom silicon and optical interconnects for hyperscalers. While TSMC offers a steadier investment due to its foundational role in chip manufacturing, Marvell, despite being higher-variance, shows significant growth potential, particularly with its custom silicon business projected to more than double by fiscal 2028.

item.title: [TSM Bullish (+0.46)] Unbreakable Shield: Why Taiwan’s Chip Expertise Cannot Be Cloned
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Bullish (+0.46)
Taiwan's semiconductor industry is a complex ecosystem, far beyond just wafer foundries, encompassing advanced packaging, materials, and a dense network of suppliers and talent. While Taiwan is building new semiconductor plants in the US, Japan, and Europe, this diversification alone will not eliminate global reliance on the island. The article argues that instead of trying to replace Taiwan, the US and Europe should focus on reinforcing Taiwan's resilience and role as a core pillar of the democratic semiconductor alliance by supporting its advancements and aligning industrial policies.

item.description:
